name: TruthLens Autonomous Research Squad
purpose: Research-control-plane orchestration for evidence-grounded verification work.

agents.responsibility: Select the next legal research action and maintain phase ordering.
Consume discovery artifacts and identify candidate papers, models, and benchmark changes.
Prepare and execute only frozen, reproducible benchmark lanes.
Identify candidate retrieval/NLI/embedding models for later benchmark evaluation.
Produce benchmark-specific metrics, artifacts, hashes, and limitations.
Run adversarial and reliability checks only after the relevant research phase is unlocked.
Enforce phase gates, metric separation, production boundary, and promotion policy.
Assemble auditable research reports and PR-ready evidence without auto-merging.
